items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well, Buddy and Zeb used to be right together all the time.

ctx.x: But like now, Buddy, he must have worked things out with Zeb pretty close.
Well, Buddy and Zeb used to be right together all the time. They could sit down and get the stuff together. It was right together.
And Zeb knew when to take the lead and stuff like that, huh?
